starter.name: Starter Box
starter.desc: Stickers, pins and the odd mini figure. The perfect first open.

pins.name: Pin Collector
pins.desc: All 12 enamel pins plus a shot at the Goldie Gold Pin.

pajama.name: Pajama Party
pajama.desc: 12 sleepy pajama figures — and the Prism Pajama Secret.

plush.name: Plush Paradise
plush.desc: Plush charms with two jumbo plush chases.

party.name: Party Series
party.desc: The full Party Series mix — every format in one box.

figure.name: Figure Vault
figure.desc: Deluxe figures on gold bases, plus the Prism Secret Figure.

secret.name: Secret Hunt
secret.desc: Every secret in the series stacked into one box.

gold.name: Golden Hour
gold.desc: Chase the Prism Limited Plush (1,800) and the Goldie Jumbo Plush (750).

boxes.name: Mystery Boxes
boxes.desc: Spin the reel and reveal real collectibles. Every box lists every item and its exact odds.
boxes.how1: Pick a box — odds are shown for every item
boxes.how2: Open up to 4 at once and watch the reels
boxes.how3: Keep, sell back for 80% or list on the market

kuji.name: Ichiban Kuji
kuji.desc: 80-ticket prize boxes where every ticket wins. Pull the very last ticket to claim the LAST ONE prize.
kuji.how1: Pick a box and pull 1, 5 or 10 tickets
kuji.how2: Watch the colour tease, then reveal Prize A–E
kuji.how3: The last ticket in the box also wins the LAST ONE

gacha.name: Gacha Machine
gacha.desc: Turn the knob and crack open a capsule. 12 mini figures plus a secret — SR guaranteed every 30 spins.
gacha.how1: Turn the knob for 1 or 5 spins
gacha.how2: Gold capsule = SR, holo capsule = Secret
gacha.how3: The pity bar guarantees an SR by spin 30

blindBox.name: Blind Box Case
blindBox.desc: Choose your own box from a 12-box case. Shake it and use hint or X-ray cards before you buy.
blindBox.how1: Tap any box in the case
blindBox.how2: Shake, hint or X-ray to narrow it down
blindBox.how3: Buy the box — or the whole case for 10% off

claw.name: Claw Machine
claw.desc: Real-physics claw game. Steer, drop and carry a plush to the chute. Power claw after 8 misses.
claw.how2: Hit GRAB to drop the claw
claw.how3: Drop the plush into the chute to win

groupPull.name: Group Pull
groupPull.desc: Join a 2–4 player room. Everyone opens 3 capsules at once — the best haul takes the champion pin.
groupPull.how3: Top total value wins the champion pin

battles.name: Box Battles
battles.desc: Open the same boxes side by side. Highest total wins a 10% pot bonus — everyone keeps their pulls.
battles.how1: Join a lobby or create your own battle
battles.how2: Each round, every player opens the same box
battles.how3: Highest total value takes the pot bonus

market.name: Market
market.desc: Buy and sell collectibles with other collectors at your own price.
market.how1: Browse listings and buy with coins
market.how2: List an item from your inventory
market.how3: Sellers pay a 5% fee when an item sells

swap.name: Swap Board
swap.desc: Post item-for-item swaps and send offers on other collectors’ posts. No coins needed.
swap.how1: Post what you have and what you want
swap.how2: Send offers on other collectors’ posts

wheel.name: Lucky Spin
wheel.desc: One free spin a day. Coins, gacha tickets, hint cards, mystery pins and an 888 jackpot.
wheel.how1: Your first spin each day is free

swap.rule2: No harassment or abuse. Repeated reports restrict your market access.
swap.rule3: Accepted trades swap instantly and can’t be reversed.
swap.rule4: Off-platform deals (payments, meetups) aren’t covered — beware of scams.
swap.rule5: Each listing uses 1 swap ticket. Offers are free.

admin.previewNote: Preview shows unsaved changes. Players only see them after you publish.

theme.presetsHelp: Pick a starting style. It sets colours, buttons, fonts, the page template, home sections and the nav — then fine-tune anything below.

games.title: Games
games.help: Each game is a separate module. Drag to reorder, hide or show it, set a badge, and optionally give it its own style — for example run Kuji in the Japanese Pop style while the site stays Western.

nav.help: Drag to reorder. Items for hidden games are skipped automatically.
nav.tooMany: Bottom tab bars work best with 5 items or fewer.
nav.desktopHelp: On screens 1024px and wider the site switches to this navigation instead of the bottom tab bar.
